description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudFormation cfn-lint Operator. Five-case proven set exercising the OPERATION_COMPLETED / REVIEW_REQUIRED classification across validation scenarios (cfn-lint + validate-template + cfn-nag + ChangeSet all clean, drift detection with stack policy IN_SYNC, SAM transform expansion and validation, nested stack validation across parent+children, cfn-nag CRITICAL findings triggering REVIEW_REQUIRED). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Full validation pipeline (cfn-lint + validate-template + cfn-nag + ChangeSet) — all clean
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — cfn-lint passes, validate-template passes, cfn-nag passes (0 critical), ChangeSet shows 1 Add + 2 Modify with no replacements
eval_cases.prompt: Validate my CloudFormation template template.yaml for stack my-app-stack in us-east-1. Run cfn-lint, validate-template, cfn-nag, and create a ChangeSet. The template creates an S3 bucket with encryption enabled and a DynamoDB table. No wildcard IAM. Stack policy protects RDS and S3.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CFN_LINT: template.yaml → my-app-stack
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Template file: template.yaml
  [✓] cfn-lint: PASSED (0 errors, 0 warnings)
  [✓] validate-template: PASSED
  [✓] cfn-nag: PASSED (0 critical, 0 warnings)
  [✓] ChangeSet: 1 Add, 2 Modify, 0 Remove — no replacements
  [✓] Stack policy: Enforced (AWS::RDS::DBInstance, AWS::S3::Bucket)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  cfn-lint template.yaml
  cfn_nag_scan --input-path template.yaml
  aws cloudformation describe-change-set --change-set-name <cs-name> --stack-name my-app-stack --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Drift detection (IN_SYNC) with stack policy enforcement
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — drift detection returns IN_SYNC, stack policy enforced protecting RDS and S3 resources
eval_cases.prompt: Run drift detection on my CloudFormation stack my-infra-stack in us-east-1. Also enforce a stack policy that protects AWS::RDS::DBInstance and AWS::S3::Bucket resources from updates. The stack has no drift.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CFN_LINT: (no template) → my-infra-stack
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Drift detection: IN_SYNC (no drift detected)
  [✓] Stack policy: Enforced (AWS::RDS::DBInstance, AWS::S3::Bucket)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudformation describe-stack-resource-drifts --stack-name my-infra-stack --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: SAM transform expansion and validation
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — SAM template expanded via sam translate, cfn-lint and cfn-nag run on expanded output, all pass
eval_cases.prompt: Validate my SAM template template-sam.yaml for stack my-serverless-stack in us-east-1. It has Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31 with two Serverless::Function resources. Expand the transform first, then run cfn-lint and cfn-nag on the expanded template.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CFN_LINT: template-sam.yaml → my-serverless-stack
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Template file: template-sam.yaml
  [✓] SAM transform: Expanded via sam translate
  [✓] cfn-lint (expanded): PASSED
  [✓] cfn-nag (expanded): PASSED
  [✓] validate-template: PASSED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  sam translate --template-file template-sam.yaml --output-file template-expanded.yaml
  cfn-lint template-expanded.yaml
  cfn_nag_scan --input-path template-expanded.yaml

eval_cases.name: Nested stack validation across parent and children
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — parent and both child templates pass cfn-lint and validate-template independently
eval_cases.prompt: Validate my CloudFormation parent template parent-template.yaml for stack my-platform-stack in us-east-1. It references two nested stacks: child-network.yaml and child-database.yaml. Run cfn-lint and validate-template on all three templates.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CFN_LINT: parent-template.yaml → my-platform-stack
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Parent template: parent-template.yaml — cfn-lint PASSED, validate-template PASSED
  [✓] Child: child-network.yaml — cfn-lint PASSED, validate-template PASSED
  [✓] Child: child-database.yaml — cfn-lint PASSED, validate-template PASSED
  [✓] Nested stacks: 2 child templates validated
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  cfn-lint parent-template.yaml
  cfn-lint child-network.yaml
  cfn-lint child-database.yaml

eval_cases.name: cfn-nag CRITICAL findings (wildcard IAM + unencrypted S3) — review required
eval_cases.branch: REVIEW_REQUIRED — cfn-nag finds 2 CRITICAL findings: IAM policy with Resource:* and S3 bucket without encryption; deployment blocked
eval_cases.prompt: Validate my CloudFormation template template.yaml for stack my-app-stack in us-east-1. The template has an IAM role with Resource: "*" in its managed policy and an S3 bucket without encryption. Run cfn-lint, validate-template, and cfn-nag.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CFN_LINT: template.yaml → my-app-stack
VERDICT: REVIEW_REQUIRED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] cfn-lint: PASSED
  [✓] validate-template: PASSED
  [!] cfn-nag: CRITICAL FINDINGS (2) — F1: IAM policy with Resource "*" in role TaskExecutionRole; W41: S3 bucket without encryption
  [✓] ChangeSet: Not created (blocked by cfn-nag findings)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  cfn_nag_scan --input-path template.yaml
